title: 1 मार्च 2027: क्या जनगणना में जाति दर्ज होगी? #Shorts
description:
PUBLISH SLOT: 20:00 IST (Sawaal window 17:00–20:00 IST). Hindi only, no English twin. Queue has no publish-time field: schedule manually.

जनगणना 2027 में जाति की गिनती होगी, जो 1931 के बाद पहली बार किसी जनगणना में होगा।
जाति का सवाल दूसरे चरण, यानी जनसंख्या गणना में फ़रवरी 2027 में पूछा जाएगा, और संदर्भ तिथि 1 मार्च 2027 की आधी रात है। इस बार परिवार se.census.gov.in पर खुद फॉर्म भरकर Self-Enumeration ID ले सकते हैं, और घर-घर गणना भी जारी रहेगी। PIB के अनुसार कुल खर्च लगभग 11,718 करोड़ रुपये है।
स्रोत: PIB "India's First Digital Enumeration Exercise" (25 अप्रैल 2026); PIB "Population Census-2027 to be conducted in two phases along with enumeration of castes"; ANI
रोज़ की ख़बर एक मिनट में समझने के लिए सब्सक्राइब करें।
Sawaal: ख़बर के पीछे का सवाल। हर तथ्य दो स्रोतों से जाँचा गया। Anchor और कुछ दृश्य AI से बने हैं।
#HindiNews #BharatNews #Census2027 #Desh #Shorts
script:
LANGUAGE: Hindi only (no English twin). Anchors: Aditya (hi-IN-MadhurNeural) and Nisha (hi-IN-SwaraNeural), channel config looks. No real politicians, no party flags. ~45s vertical.

SCRIPT (English master; adapt into Hindi):
ADITYA: Will the next census ask your caste? Yes. It will be the first caste count in a census since 1931.
NISHA: According to PIB, the census reference date is midnight, 1 March 2027. Caste will be recorded in the second phase, population enumeration, due in February 2027.
ADITYA: New this time: self-enumeration. Families can fill the form themselves online at se.census.gov.in and get a Self-Enumeration ID before the enumerator visits. Door-to-door visits continue.
NISHA: PIB calls it India's first digital enumeration exercise. Enumerators will use a mobile app. The outlay is about 11,718 crore rupees.
NISHA: Some answers have not been announced yet. When will the caste data be made public? How will caste names be grouped?
ADITYA: Will your family fill the census form online? Comment yes or no, and the question you want answered.

EDIT PLAN (Mr. Cut, 20 shots, 45.0s): hook 0-3s "1931 के बाद पहली बार? जाति गिनती?"; dates 3-11s; self-enumeration 11-21s with official portal screenshot or text-card backup; digital census + ≈₹11,718 करोड़ 21-30s; open questions 30-38s; CTA + end card "फ़रवरी 2027: जनगणना चरण II (जाति सहित)" 38-45s. Confirm licences for shots 1, 8, 15 or use text-card backups. If Hindi VO exceeds 48s, drop shot 12, then 17.

PINNED COMMENT: PIB के अनुसार जाति की गिनती जनगणना के दूसरे चरण में होगी। क्या आपका परिवार फॉर्म ऑनलाइन भरेगा? हाँ या ना लिखें, और वह एक सवाल भी जो आप पूछना चाहते हैं।

THUMBNAIL (no faces): huge yellow "1931" centre on deep-blue background, faded India map and census-form lines behind, white text "1931 के बाद पहली बार".

NOTE: Title uses the alternate because the primary (62 characters) broke the under-60 rule.

Nisha.look: Indian woman, about 30, news anchor, dusky skin, straight shoulder-length black hair, silver hoop earrings, steel-blue blazer over a white shirt, in a dark studio

relevance.why: PIB confirms caste will be counted in Phase II (Feb 2027), so the facts hold and the script matches the title. The self-enumeration framing may be stale, since the house-listing phase already ran Apr–Sep 2026. Caste-census demand is solid, but the channel's reach is small.
